_metadata.description: Portal Everywhere mandatory acceptance obligations; planned evidence is not completion.

requirements.title: Terminal parity
requirements.description: Given an existing PTY session is running, when desktop support is enabled, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: Terminal byte and resize semantics remain correct.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case REM-01 in the vrooli-bridge producer suite. Required assertion: Terminal byte and resize semantics remain correct. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.

requirements.title: Protocol confusion
requirements.description: Given a terminal frame is sent to a desktop session, when admission evaluates it, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: It rejects the wrong protocol.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case REM-02 in the vrooli-bridge producer suite. Required assertion: It rejects the wrong protocol. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.

requirements.title: Node revocation
requirements.description: Given media and input channels are active, when the node is revoked, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: Existing channels lose authority.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case REM-03 in the vrooli-bridge producer suite. Required assertion: Existing channels lose authority. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.

requirements.title: Loss before effect
requirements.description: Given the route disconnects before command admission, when the client reconnects, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: The owner can safely resume the unperformed step.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case REM-04 in the vrooli-bridge producer suite. Required assertion: The owner can safely resume the unperformed step. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.

requirements.title: Loss after effect
requirements.description: Given the route disconnects after submission, when an alternate provider is available, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: The original receipt is reconciled before fallback.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case REM-05 in the vrooli-bridge producer suite. Required assertion: The original receipt is reconciled before fallback. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.

requirements.title: Slow viewer
requirements.description: Given a viewer cannot consume frames, when the stream continues, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: Queues remain bounded and stop remains responsive.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case REM-06 in the vrooli-bridge producer suite. Required assertion: Queues remain bounded and stop remains responsive. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.

requirements.title: Relay only
requirements.description: Given direct peer connectivity is unavailable, when a supported relay route is selected, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: Authorized viewing works with recorded cost and latency.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case REM-07 in the vrooli-bridge producer suite. Required assertion: Authorized viewing works with recorded cost and latency. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.

requirements.title: Attached revoke
requirements.description: Given a device grant is revoked while the host stays online, when device input arrives, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: Device control stops without revoking unrelated host sessions.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case REM-08 in the vrooli-bridge producer suite. Required assertion: Device control stops without revoking unrelated host sessions. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.
